description: This file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'NodeType' for extracting node type data from the database, including configuration and comment-related fields.

classes.name: NodeType
classes.description: A migration source plugin class for extracting Drupal 7 node type data from the database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query to fetch node type records.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of field descriptions for node types, including comment fields if the comment module exists.

methods.name: getCommentFields
methods.description: Provides comment-related field descriptions for node types.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Initializes teaser length and node preview settings from configuration variables.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each row with additional properties such as options, body field info, and comment settings.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the primary key for the source data, which is 'type'.
